blocks.text: Stem cells khaas (unique) cells hain jin mein jism ke bohat se mukhtalif qisam ke cells ban jane ki hairat-angez salahiyat (ability) hai. Jab stem cell divide hota hai to har naya cell ya to stem cell hi reh sakta hai ya specialized (khaas kaam wala) cell ban sakta hai, jaise muscle cell, red blood cell ya dimagh (brain) ka cell. Jitni qisam ke cells yeh bana sakte hain, us ke hisab se stem cells ki bari qismein yeh hain:

items: Totipotent: yeh stem cells har mumkin qisam ka cell ban sakte hain. Misal: zygote (fertilized egg) aur zygote ki pehli chand divisions se bane cells.
Pluripotent: yeh taqreeban har qisam ka cell ban sakte hain. Misal: shuruati (early) embryo ke cells.

Multipotent: yeh aapas mein qareebi rishta rakhne wale cells ke ek khandan (family) mein badal sakte hain. Misal: hematopoietic (khoon banane wale) stem cells red blood cells, white blood cells ya platelets ban sakte hain.
Oligopotent: yeh sirf chand qisam ke cells ban sakte hain. Misal: adult lymphoid ya myeloid stem cells.
Unipotent: yeh sirf ek hi qisam ke cells, yani apni hi qisam, bana sakte hain. Phir bhi yeh stem cells hain kyun ke yeh khud ko dobara bana (renew kar) sakte hain. Misal: adult muscle stem cells.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Stem cell woh cell hai jo (1) divide ho kar apne jaisa stem cell bhi bana sakta hai aur (2) khaas kaam wale cells bhi. "Potent" ka matlab taqat hai: toti = sab, pluri = bohat, multi = kai (ek khandan), oligo = chand, uni = sirf ek.
Use of Stem Cells (stem cells ke istemal)

items: Regenerative Medicine (dobara banane wali tib): stem cells kharab tissues aur organs ki marammat kar sakte hain ya un ki jagah naye bana sakte hain. Is liye inhen spinal cord (haram maghz) ki chot, type 1 diabetes, Parkinson's disease aur dil ki beemari ke ilaj mein istemal kiya jata hai.

Drug Testing and Development (dawaon ki jaanch aur tayyari): stem cells ko khaas qisam ke cells mein badal kar researchers insani beemariyon ke models bana sakte hain. Is se dawaon ke asar ki zyada durust jaanch hoti hai aur janwaron par tajurbon ki zaroorat kam hoti hai.

Personalized Medicine (har mareez ke liye alag ilaj): stem cells mareez ke apne cells se banaye ja sakte hain, is liye ilaj mein immune rejection (jism ka naye cells ko rad karna) ka khatra kam hota hai. Yeh tareeqa zyada moassar aur mehfooz ilaj de sakta hai.

blocks.text: Categories of Stem Cells (asal ke lihaz se qismein)
Stem cells kahan se aate hain (origin), is ke hisab se in ki bari qismein yeh hain:

ESCs blastocysts (bilkul shuruati embryos) ke inner cell mass (andar wale cells ke gucche) se liye jate hain. Yeh stem cells pluripotent hain, yani jism ke taqreeban har qisam ke cell ban sakte hain. In ki differentiation ki salahiyat bohat zyada hai, is liye yeh research aur ilaj ke liye bohat kaam ke hain. ESCs ke istemal par ethical (akhlaqi) aitrazat mein insani embryos ka istemal, teratoma (ek qisam ki rasoli) banne ka khatra aur mumkina immune rejection shamil hain.

Yeh stem cells jism ke kai tissues mein milte hain, jaise bone marrow (haddi ka gooda), fat (charbi) aur khoon. Yeh multipotent hain, yani sirf apne tissue se jure chand qisam ke cells ban sakte hain. In ke istemal par akhlaqi aitraz kam hai, aur agar mareez ke apne tissues se liye jayen to immune rejection ka khatra bhi kam hai. Lekin in ki differentiation ki salahiyat mehdood hai aur inhen alag karna aur lab mein ugana (culture karna) mushkil hai.

Yeh lab mein banaye jate hain: adult somatic (jism ke aam) cells ko khaas transcription factors (genes ko on/off karne wale proteins) ke zariye reprogram kar ke wapas pluripotent halat mein laya jata hai. Yeh embryonic stem cells ki tarah pluripotent hain.

iPSCs ke faide: in par embryonic stem cells jaisa akhlaqi aitraz nahi, kyun ke in ke liye embryo khatam nahi karna parta. Yeh mareez ke apne cells se banaye ja sakte hain, is liye immune rejection ka khatra bohat kam hota hai. In se kharab tissues aur organs dobara banane ki umeed hai, jaise dil ke mareezon ke liye naye heart cells ya neurodegenerative (dimagh ke cells ke kamzor ho kar marne wali) beemariyon ke mareezon ke liye naye neurons.

iPSCs ke nuqsanat: reprogramming ke amal se genetic tabdeeliyan aa sakti hain jo iPSCs par asar dalen. Mareez mein lagane par yeh tumours (teratomas) bana sakte hain. iPSCs ko kisi khaas, poori tarah kaam karne wale cell mein badalna abhi bhi mushkil kaam hai, aur yeh yaqeeni banana bhi mushkil hai ke yeh cells theek kaam karen.

blocks.alt: Insani jism aur lambi haddi ke saath stem cells ke teen zariye: haddi ke gooday (bone marrow) se nikle stem cells jo dish mein adult stem cells ban kar barhte hain; jild (skin) se liye gaye fibroblasts jo dish mein barha kar reprogramming se induced pluripotent stem cells bante hain; aur blastocyst ke cells jo dish mein embryonic stem cells ban kar barhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Darja-bandi karen: (a) zygote, (b) haematopoietic stem cell, (c) baligh muscle stem cell, (d) shuruati embryo ka cell. Phir batayen ke stem cells ka kaun sa zariya embryo ki tabahi aur immune rejection dono se bachata hai, aur us ke istemal ka ek khatra batayen.
blocks.explanation: (a) Totipotent. (b) Multipotent. (c) Unipotent. (d) Pluripotent. Induced pluripotent stem cells dono se bachate hain, kyunke yeh mareez ke apne baligh cells se bante hain; khatron mein dobara programming se genetic tabdeeliyan aur teratoma banna shamil hain.

items: Stem cell khud ko dobara banata hai aur makhsoos ho sakta hai. Salahiyat ke lihaz se: totipotent (zygote), pluripotent (shuruati embryo), multipotent (blood stem cells), oligopotent (lymphoid, myeloid), unipotent (muscle stem cells).
Istemal: regenerative medicine, beemari ke models par dawaon ki jaanch, mareez ke apne cells se personalised medicine.

Asal ke lihaz se: embryonic (pluripotent; akhlaqi tashweesh, teratoma, rejection), adult (multipotent; kam akhlaqi masail, kam rejection, magar mehdood aur culture mein mushkil), induced pluripotent (dobara program kiye baligh cells; embryos nahin, kam rejection, magar genetic tabdeeliyan, teratomas aur simt dena mushkil).
